newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices rise slightly at auction.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices rise slightly at auction.

text.p: Bangladesh tea prices rose slightly at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
Traditional buyers for Pakistan and Poland supported the market by bidding actively for best quality teas.
Local blenders also operated strongly, they said.
Some 813,793 kg of tea were sold at the auction. The average price was 50.24 taka per kg, 0.28 taka up from the previous sale.
The next auction will be held on January 21 with an expected offer of 1.04 million kg. ($1 = 42.45 taka)
